title: Change request: allow partial payments on an invoice
body:
Raised by Laura Chen at the kickoff (`meetings/week-01-kickoff.md`). Some large customers pay one invoice in two or three parts.

Today PAY-04 in `requirements/payments.md` says a payment is applied only when it covers the full open amount. Partial payments are not allowed.

Change: allow several payments on one invoice until the invoice is fully paid. The invoice shows the open amount after each payment.

Owner: Aisha Rahman. Impact check: Tom Becker. Due: Week 3.
